title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: federated Copilot connectors read third-party data in real time
summary: Hold: the briefing says administrators cannot switch off write tools separately from a connector, but Microsoft documents tool-level blocking under Agents > Tools. The roadmap facts, licensing and listed administration paths are supported; the claim about missing write-tool controls must be narrowed.
